lines.line: Summary: The best-known enemy in the series, a big grub-dog with a red back and white spots, called the Spotty Bulborb in the first game and the Red Bulborb in Pikmin 2. It sleeps in the open by day, wakes when it is attacked or when something is carried right next to it, and then lunges at Pikmin and leaders to eat them.

quoted: known as the Spotty Bulborb in Pikmin and the Red Bulborb
Bulborbs are the most prominent enemies in the franchise
Bulborbs have pointed snouts, eyes on stalks, and red backs with white spots.
Bulborbs are the most commonly encountered member of the Grub-dog family of enemies.
Bulborbs are nocturnal creatures, and sleep in open locations during the day.
they won't wake up until they are attacked
An object being carried adjacent to a Bulborb can also wake up the enemy.
Once awake, they become aggressive and will run towards nearby Pikmin or leaders, lunging in an attempt to eat them.

lines.line: Weak points: Purple Pikmin do serious damage, especially when their landing stuns it. If a lot of Pikmin attack at once, it shakes them off and goes back to trying to eat.

quoted: A few Purple Pikmin can cause serious damage, especially if they stun the Red Bulborb.
If there are a lot of Pikmin attacking it at once, it will shake them off and then start trying to eat again.

lines.line: Tips: With an army of at least 30 Pikmin, keep tossing Pikmin onto its back, even if some are shaken off, rather than swarming it. If you wake it by accident, run until it turns around, then make a new pass. With a very small army, wake it and lead it far from where it sleeps; when it walks home and settles down, attacking at that moment gives a few seconds in which it cannot move or bite. In some metal-themed caves you can lead it off the edge by running around a hole in the sublevel.

quoted: Rather than swarming it, continuously tossing Pikmin onto its back is preferable when the army is at least 30 Pikmin strong, even if some are shaken off.
If it is accidentally awakened before being attacked by Pikmin, you should run away until it turns around, then make a new pass at it.

If the Pikmin army is very small, another strategy is to wake up the Red Bulborb and make it chase the leader until it goes far enough away from its starting location, at which point it will turn around and return to its original sleeping spot.
Once it returns there, attacking at the moment it starts sleeping can provide the player with a few crucial seconds in which the Red Bulborb is entirely immobilized and harmless.
In some metal-themed caves, Red Bulborbs can be led off of the stage by awakening it and quickly running around a hole in the sublevel, causing it to fall off.

lines.line: Summary: A small, common enemy called the Dwarf Red Bulborb in Pikmin 2. It looks like a young bulborb but is really a breadbug copying a bulborb's look. It barks and chases when it spots a leader or Pikmin, bites one Pikmin at a time and chews it slowly, and never strays far from its territory.

quoted: named the Dwarf Red Bulborb
is a small and common enemy in the Pikmin series.
they are actually a different species in the breadbug family, and mimic the appearance of Bulborbs to evade predation.
they will audibly bark and begin pursuit. Dwarf Bulborbs will never stray far from their territory.
They can only catch and eat one Pikmin at a time.
they will slowly chew their catch before swallowing

lines.line: Weak points: A single Pikmin thrown onto its back kills it, and its low health means swarming works too. Killing it while it chews frees the Pikmin it caught. Purple Pikmin are exceptionally effective: they steer onto a nearby enemy when thrown, and quick throws at a group stun the whole group and likely kill most of it.

quoted: Throwing a single Pikmin onto their back will kill them instantly, and their fairly low health makes swarming a viable tactic as well.
killing the Bulborb during this process will free the Pikmin.
Purple Pikmin are exceptionally effective.
Rapidly throwing Purple Pikmin in the general vicinity of a group will stun the entire group, as well as likely kill most, if not all of them.
a small homing system will swerve the Pikmin's fall and make it land on a nearby enemy

lines.line: Tips: It is no threat alone; the danger is numbers, or a dwarf standing next to other enemies, so deal with the dwarfs first in a mixed fight. Purples work well on a crowd, as on the eighth sublevel of the Cavern of Chaos. In Pikmin 2 it does not call for help: the scream that wakes a nearby bulborb happens only in the first game. If you lead it past its range it gives up and walks home.

quoted: Their only true threat comes in their numbers or when they appear near other enemies, in which case they may be able to eat a Pikmin or two in the chaos of the battle. Prioritizing them first should simplify things
This is particularly handy for sublevels with huge numbers of them, such as the Cavern of Chaos's eighth sublevel.
Exclusively in the first game, pestering one for long enough will prompt it to scream for help, waking up the nearest Spotty Bulborb
If led outside of a certain range, they will stop chasing their target and return to where they started.

lines.line: Summary: A pig-like enemy that shoots fire from its red snout, found commonly in Pikmin 2. It wanders a very small patch, turns to face any leader or Pikmin it notices, and breathes a stream of fire. When Pikmin latch on, it bucks them off into the area in front of it and breathes fire there.

quoted: is a pig-like enemy in Pikmin, Pikmin 2, Pikmin 3, and Pikmin 4
As the name would imply, Fiery Blowhogs shoot fire from their red snouts.
are found commonly in Pikmin 2 and Pikmin 3
Fiery Blowhogs typically wander around a very small zone aimlessly
it will rotate to face them, before spewing out a stream of fire
In the first two games, when provoked by Pikmin, Fiery Blowhogs will buck them off into an area in front of them and shoot fire.

lines.line: Weak points: Purple Pikmin thrown onto it do serious damage and stop it bucking Pikmin off or breathing fire. It is easier to kill in Pikmin 2, so a big group can swarm it straight away. It must breathe in before it breathes out, and it cannot turn or move from the start of that breath until the end, so its flame does not follow anyone who runs away.

quoted: since they are easier to kill in Pikmin 2, a large Pikmin group can swarm it right away for the kill.
throwing Purple Pikmin on it will deal serious damage to the Blowhog, as well as rendering unable to buck the Pikmin off, or breathe fire.
it must inhale first, which creates a short delay before firing in which the attack may be avoided.
From the moment the creature begins inhaling to the moment it's done spitting fire, it will not rotate or move, meaning the spray of fire will not follow leaders or Pikmin running away.

lines.line: Tips: Any Pikmin type can beat it. Pikmin clinging to it cannot be set alight and Red Pikmin ignore fire; the page warns that being bucked into water is what can kill them, so turn it away from water first. In Pikmin 2 a Blowhog may not fire when only a leader is close to it.

quoted: Fiery Blowhog: This enemy shoots fire towards the player, but can be defeated with any Pikmin type.
Red Pikmin also exhibit an immunity to fire, in that they ignore the heat
The same strategy described above works equally well here
Pikmin that are swarming a Fiery Blowhog cannot be ignited, meaning they're safe from its attack.
they cannot be killed, unless the Fiery Blowhog bucks them into water.
unless the Fiery Blowhog bucks them into water. Make sure you make the Blowhog faces away from any water sources.
In Pikmin 2, Blowhogs may not shoot fire if only a leader is present nearby.

lines.line: Summary: A large, flatter-bodied white frog found underground, called the Wollyhop on the wiki and the Wollywog in some games and regions. It is passive until a leader or Pikmin comes close, then leaps and lands on them, and the landing kills every Pikmin within a wide radius.

quoted: is a frog-like enemy found in subterranean areas in Pikmin, Pikmin 2, and Pikmin 4
known as the Wollywog depending on the game and region
Wollyhops have lost most of their skin pigmentation, giving them an albino-like appearance.
the Wollyhop is also a large creature with large eyes
their albino body is much more flatter
Generally passive, they will only attack by leaping into the air if a leader or Pikmin comes nearby.
Upon falling, a Wollyhop's attack covers a considerable radius, killing all Pikmin within it.

lines.line: Weak points: Purple Pikmin slams do large damage and may briefly stun it. Swarming works less well in Pikmin 2 than in the first game, so throw Pikmin onto it instead of sending them all in.

quoted: In Pikmin 2, making use of the Purple Pikmin's slam attack is useful, as they are capable of dealing large amounts of damage with the chance to stun it briefly.
Swarming is less effective in this game, so you should be throwing your Pikmin instead.

lines.line: Tips: When it is in the air, whistle your Pikmin off before it lands, so they do not fly off and possibly lose their maturity. Even a Wollywog killed as it is about to fall still crushes the Pikmin under it.

quoted: When the Wollyhop is airborne, whistle your Pikmin off before it lands, so they don't fly off and potentially lose their maturity.
Even if a Wollyhop is defeated as it is about to fall, any Pikmin caught beneath it will still be killed.

lines.line: Summary: The red spray, made by gathering ten ultra-spicy berries from Burgeoning Spiderworts or from a concentrated dose of spray nectar. In Pikmin 2 it makes every Pikmin in the current leader's squad faster and quicker at its jobs for 40 seconds, however far away they are.

quoted: is a red-colored spray that is mainly concocted by gathering ten ultra-spicy berries, or obtained from concentrated doses.
Collecting ten ultra-spicy berries from Burgeoning Spiderworts.
Collecting ultra-spicy spray nectar.
Pikmin 2 and Pikmin 3: Affects all Pikmin in the current leader's squad, regardless of distance.
The effects wear off after 40 seconds in Pikmin 2.

lines.line: Uses: Sprayed Pikmin run nearly as fast as flowered White Pikmin and work faster: they attack more often and tear down gates, build bridges and get up from knockdowns quicker. In Pikmin 2 the leaf, bud or flower is replaced by a flashing pink light rather than turning into a flower, and they carry as if flowered, so spraying a squad that is already all flowers is a waste. Their attack power becomes the same for every colour, so Purple Pikmin hit weaker while sprayed. A Pikmin that jumps at its target before hitting, instead of latching on, is not sped up.

quoted: in Pikmin 2 and Pikmin 3 they become nearly as fast as flowered White Pikmin

Affected Pikmin also receive a general increase in task speed, which affects their attack frequency, their efficiency when taking down gates, constructing bridges, and recovering from being knocked down.
In Pikmin 2, an affected Pikmin's leaf, bud, or flower will be replaced with a pink flashing light
In Pikmin 2, all the spray does is make the Pikmin behave as if they are flower Pikmin, meaning that spraying a group that is already all flowers is a complete waste.
Technically, any Pikmin type's attack power is changed to 10 in Pikmin 2 and Pikmin 3
This means that Purple Pikmin and Rock Pikmin experience a decrease in power
a Pikmin that is attacking without being latched on (evident by them first jumping at the target before landing a blow) will not be sped up.

lines.line: Tips: Spraying already-spicy Pikmin restarts the 40 seconds, and so does an ultra-bitter spray. Pikmin that go into an Onion or the ship lose the effect, and Pikmin that are drowning die faster. If it wears off while Pikmin are carrying something they keep the powered-up carrying speed until they deliver it or drop it, which helps with the Doomsday Apparatus. The Awakening Wood is the place to gather lots of berries.

quoted: if the player sprays an already spicy Pikmin, the duration of the spray will be reset. Interestingly, if the player uses an ultra-bitter spray on a spicy Pikmin, it will also reset its spicy mode duration.
If Pikmin enter an Onion or the Hocotate ship, or are converted into a sprout, they will lose their spicy status.
drowning Pikmin sprayed with an ultra-spicy spray will actually die more quickly than unsprayed Pikmin.

If the effects of the spray wear off while the Pikmin are carrying the object, they will continue carrying at the same speed as if they were powered up, until they deliver the object or drop it. This makes this exploit particularly useful when retrieving the Doomsday Apparatus
The player can gather lots of ultra-spicy spray berries in the Awakening Wood.

lines.line: Summary: The purple spray, made from ten purple Burgeoning Spiderwort berries or found as a concentrated dose. Any enemy or bomb rock in the direction of your cursor is immobilized and slowly turns to stone for about nine seconds: one second for the stone to form and eight of full encasement.

quoted: is the purple colored spray in Pikmin 2 that the player can get from ten purple Burgeoning Spiderwort berries, or by finding a concentrated dose.
Any enemy or bomb-rock in the direction of the cursor instantly becomes immobilized and slowly turns into stone.
In total, this effect lasts for nine seconds – one second for the stones to form, and eight seconds of complete encasement.

lines.line: Uses: Petrifying an enemy that is eating Pikmin saves them, and a bomb rock in mid-countdown freezes, giving you time to run. The enemy shakes just before it breaks free. While it is stone, ordinary Pikmin attacks and leader punches do 1.5 times damage to most enemies, but only a quarter to bosses such as the Empress Bulblax, Man-at-Legs and Beady Long Legs, almost nothing to the Bloysters (0.03 times), and half to the Titan Dweevil, which can only be hurt when unarmed. Purple Pikmin stomps and bomb-rock damage are unchanged.

quoted: Petrifying enemies that are in the process of eating any Pikmin will make it possible to save those Pikmin from dying. Likewise, bomb-rocks that were in the middle of their countdown will freeze, allowing the leaders and Pikmin a chance of reaching safety.
Before reaching this point, the enemy begins shaking, as an indication that the petrification is wearing off.
All enemies not listed || 1.50×
Empress Bulblax || 0.25×
Man-at-Legs || 0.25×
Beady Long Legs || 0.25×
Ranging Bloyster || 0.03×
Toady Bloyster || 0.03×
Titan Dweevil || 0.50× || Can only be damaged when unarmed.
Purple Pikmin stomps and bomb-rock damage is not changed either way.

lines.line: Tips: Aim before you press: with no enemy near, the dose is wasted. It is rarer than the spicy spray: fewer berry plants carry it, and you find it only after getting White Pikmin, near the Bulblax Kingdom. A petrified Bumbling Snitchbug drops the leader it was holding. An enemy killed while it is stone crumbles and leaves drops of nectar or spray, and a Titan Dweevil killed that way drops 10 random sprays.

quoted: If there are no enemies nearby, the leader will still spray it in the air, wasting one dosage.
There are fewer ultra-bitter berry carrying Burgeoning Spiderworts, which makes the spray harder to obtain in comparison to ultra-spicy sprays.
ultra-bitter spray is not found until after the acquisition of White Pikmin, near the Bulblax Kingdom.
Bumbling Snitchbugs will instantly drop whatever leader they are holding.
When an enemy is defeated while petrified, it will crumble to dust and leave behind some drops of liquid
if the Titan Dweevil is defeated when it is petrified, it will drop 10 random sprays

lines.line: Summary: A large drop of liquid that turns leaf and bud Pikmin into flowers. Any leaf or bud Pikmin that passes a drop on the ground crouches and slurps it for about two seconds, whether it was idle or sent there, and then jumps up with a flower on its head.

quoted: is a substance that increases the maturity of Pikmin, usually to the flower stage.
It comes in the form of large drops of liquid that Pikmin can drink.

Any leaf or bud Pikmin that pass by a drop of nectar on the ground will crouch down and begin to slurp it for roughly two seconds, regardless of whether it is idle or has been directed to it. At the end of the slurp, it will jump up and the leaf or bud on its head will turn into a flower.

lines.line: Uses: In Pikmin 2 one drop can be shared by any number of Pikmin, but once the first Pikmin starts drinking, the drop shrinks until it is gone when that Pikmin finishes, so only Pikmin that start drinking in that window are flowered. The window is longer in Pikmin 2 than in the first game. The best way to flower many at once is to get them to swarm in a tight group.

quoted: In Pikmin and Pikmin 2, a single drop of nectar can be shared by any number of Pikmin, but as soon as one Pikmin starts to drink it, the drop will shrink until it disappears when the first Pikmin is done.
This means that only Pikmin which start drinking the nectar within this time window will be flowered.
The time window is quite strict in Pikmin, but lasts longer in Pikmin 2.
The most effective way to get a large number of Pikmin drinking the same nectar drop is by swarming them in a tight group.

lines.line: Tips: The wiki lists nectar weed patches, piles of rubble, eggs, Honeywisps, Mitites, Bulborb Larvae and petrified enemies among the sources; most give a single drop and sometimes more.

quoted: Most of these sources will produce a single drop of nectar most of the time, but can sometimes produce more.
Nectar weed patches
Piles of rubble
Eggs - Honeywisps
Honeywisps
Mitites
Bulborb Larvae
Petrified or frozen enemies

lines.line: Summary: A white, semi-round object found in cave alcoves and a few places above ground. Attack it and it breaks open and releases nectar, or sometimes other things, including living creatures. In Pikmin 2 the eggs that Honeywisps hold work the same as eggs on the ground.

quoted: A nectar egg (known as an egg prior to Pikmin 3) is a white, semi-round object found in alcoves of caves, and on specific places aboveground.
They can be attacked, and when broken, they release nectar, although they can also release other things including living creatures.
The eggs held by Honeywisps in Pikmin 2 function identically to grounded eggs.

lines.line: Uses: What comes out is chosen at random at the moment the egg breaks: a single drop of nectar half the time (50 percent), two drops 35 percent, a drop of ultra-bitter spray 5 percent, a drop of ultra-spicy spray 5 percent, and a group of ten Mitites 5 percent. In story mode, if the draw is a spray you have not unlocked yet, you get a single drop of nectar instead.

quoted: In Pikmin 2, the contents of an egg are picked at random from a list, and they're only chosen on the exact moment the egg breaks, not when the egg is created
A single drop of nectar || 50%
Two drops of nectar || 35%
A drop of ultra-bitter spray || 5%
A drop of ultra-spicy spray || 5%
A group of ten Mitites || 5%
In story mode, if the game decided on a drop of spray nectar, but the player has not yet unlocked that spray, the outcome will instead be changed to a single drop of nectar.

lines.line: Tips: You can break one with Pikmin, with leader punches, or with an enemy projectile such as a Gatling Groink's mortars. A Purple Pikmin thrown at it breaks it at once and defeats any Mitites inside straight away. Using a leader is also recommended, because a thrown Pikmin that is called back may drink the nectar and waste it.

quoted: To destroy an egg, it must be attacked with Pikmin, punched at a few times with a leader, or destroyed by an enemy projectile, like a Gatling Groink's mortars.
For Pikmin 2, it is advisable to throw a Purple Pikmin onto an egg, as this will immediately break it and contained Mitites will be instantly defeated.
It is also recommended to destroy an egg with a leader, as a Pikmin thrown at the egg may drink the nectar after being called back, wasting it.

lines.line: Summary: The only permanent Pikmin type that can safely go into water; the other types flail in panic and drown. In Pikmin 2 five are found in the Awakening Wood, chasing Wolpoles beyond an electric gate that you break down with Yellow Pikmin.

quoted: Blue Pikmin are the only permanent Pikmin type which can safely enter water and traverse the floor underneath
will simply flail around in panic before drowning if they are immersed
In Pikmin 2, 5 Blue Pikmin are found in the Awakening Wood.
They are found chasing a few Wolpoles beyond an electric gate guarded by a Cloaking Burrow-nit at the north of the map.
Olimar and Louie break down the gate with the Yellow Pikmin

lines.line: Uses: Required: the Shower Room (its entrance is blocked by a clog underwater), the Submerged Castle (the entrance is underwater and only Blue Pikmin can enter, even with exploits), and the second half of the Valley of Repose, where Blues must destroy a white bramble gate and a clog just past the Emergence Cave; that opens the Subterranean Complex and Frontier Cavern. Only Blue Pikmin can use seesaw blocks that are underwater.

quoted: Blue Pikmin are required to collect these treasures or enter these caves, and there are no glitches or exploits that allow other Pikmin types to do so.
Shower Room: The entrance to the cave is blocked by a clog underwater.
Submerged Castle: Only Blue Pikmin can enter this cave, as its entrance is underwater. Even with exploits, only Blue Pikmin are allowed to enter.
to access the parts of the Valley of Repose not accessible on day 1 and 2, Blue Pikmin must be used to destroy a white bramble gate and a clog just past the Emergence Cave.
Subterranean Complex
Frontier Cavern
Air Brake: Only Blue Pikmin can use the seesaw blocks that are underwater.

lines.line: Tips: In Pikmin 2 an idle Blue Pikmin that sees a Pikmin drowning nearby runs in, picks it up and throws it to shore, unless the drowning one is too far away. They can also lift a Purple Pikmin out of water. Otherwise their attack, toughness and speed are about average, and they are more likely to die than other types in Pikmin 2.

quoted: In the first two games, if they are idle and see a nearby Pikmin drowning in water, they will quickly run to them, pick them up, and throw them to shore. However, they will not rescue Pikmin if they are a certain distance away, so they can't always be relied on.
Blue Pikmin have largely average attack power, durability, mobility, digging speed and throw distance.
Interestingly, Blue Pikmin are more likely to die than other types in Pikmin 2
Despite their weight, Blue Pikmin can grab them and chuck them out of water just fine in Pikmin 2.

lines.line: Summary: Pikmin with large ears that can be thrown higher than any other type, which reaches high ledges and lets them latch onto the Beady Long Legs. Pikmin 2 makes them immune to electricity. Five are found in the Perplexing Pool; White Pikmin are needed just to reach them, and a Fiery Bulblax guards the entrance to their Onion.

quoted: they have large ears and can be thrown higher than other Pikmin, which is useful for collecting high-up objects, latching on to enemies like the Beady Long Legs
Pikmin 2 introduces electrical hazards, with Yellow Pikmin now being immune to them
a group of five Yellow Pikmin are found in the Perplexing Pool near the center of the map
White Pikmin are necessary just to reach them, and a Fiery Bulblax guards the entrance to their Onion.

lines.line: Uses: Only Yellow Pikmin can destroy the electric gate in front of the Blue Onion, and they handle electric enemies and hazards that kill other types on contact. None of it is strictly required: no task in Pikmin 2 needs them exclusively. Their old bomb-rock carrying does not work in Pikmin 2, where bomb rocks are only a hazard.

quoted: The electric gate that blocks the path to the Blue Onion can only be destroyed by Yellows.
This newfound electrical immunity makes Yellow Pikmin very helpful in dealing with electrical enemies and hazards that can instantly kill other Pikmin types, as well as tearing down electric gates.
There is no task in Pikmin 2 that requires Yellow Pikmin exclusively.
Their ability to carry bomb-rocks does not factor into this game, since bomb-rocks now only appear as a hazard for the leaders' squads and cannot be carried by any Pikmin.

lines.line: Tips: They are recommended against a pair of Anode Beetles, which make a line of electricity that fatally shocks any non-Yellow Pikmin touching it; against Anode Dweevils, which shock every non-Yellow Pikmin under them after being attacked; and against the Titan Dweevil's electric weapon.

quoted: Anode Beetle: Two Anode Beetles can create a line of electricity between themselves, fatally electrocuting any non-Yellow Pikmin that come in contact.
Anode Dweevil: Anode Dweevils, after being attacked themselves, produce an electric field directly below them, shocking and killing any non-Yellow Pikmin underneath.

Titan Dweevil: One weapon this boss has creates several metal balls that land in the arena and chain together a long electrical current between themselves and the weapon, instantly killing any non-Yellow Pikmin that touch the chain of sparks.

lines.line: Summary: Purple Pikmin have the strength of ten Pikmin. They are first found at a pair of Violet Candypop Buds in the Emergence Cave, where a treasure that needs 101 Pikmin to lift is waiting.

quoted: These Pikmin have the strength of 10 Pikmin
When Olimar and Louie venture into the Emergence Cave, they see the top half of a globe, but it requires more than 100 Pikmin to lift – it needs 101.
find a pair of Violet Candypop Buds

lines.line: Uses: Required for the Spherical Atlas, the first treasure that opens a new area and needs 101 Pikmin, and for the Geographic Projection, which is the same; for the Professional Noisemaker, which sits inside the Waterwraith; and for the Doomsday Apparatus, which needs 1000 Pikmin or 100 Purples. They are also what makes the Waterwraith vulnerable. The best place to get that many is the Subterranean Complex: on sublevel 8, use the Queen Candypop Buds first and then the Violet ones to make 15 Purples and 2 of another type.

quoted: Spherical Atlas: The first "new area" treasure in the game requires 101 Pikmin to carry, meaning some Purple Pikmin will have to be used.
Geographic Projection: Same as the Spherical Atlas.
Professional Noisemaker: The treasure is inside the Waterwraith, which requires Purple Pikmin to defeat.
Doomsday Apparatus: This treasure requires 1000 Pikmin to carry, or 100 Purple Pikmin.
Waterwraith: The creature is invulnerable, but Purple Pikmin stomps make it vulnerable to all Pikmin attacks.
The best place to get so many would be the Subterranean Complex.
until you reach the eighth one, with an exit geyser, Candypop Buds and some eggs.
Use the Queen Candypop Buds first and the Violet Candypop Buds after to produce 15 Purple Pikmin and 2 Red Pikmin, Blue Pikmin or Yellow Pikmin.

lines.line: Tips: Their landing thump stuns most enemies one time in three, for five seconds, and a small homing steer puts them onto a nearby enemy, so the aim need not be exact. The thump kills Shearwigs and Dwarf Bulborbs, breaks nectar eggs at once, defeats Mitites in a wide radius, switches off fire geysers and electric wires, and counts as an attack against poison emitters and Fiery Bulblaxes. They do not panic at Mitites or at the roar of Emperor Bulblaxes, but they are slow, and slower still when carrying. Some bosses are harder to stun or cannot be stunned.

quoted: Most enemies have a one in three chance of being stunned, and they will stay stunned for a full five seconds.
a small homing system will swerve the Pikmin's fall and make it land on a nearby enemy
fatally injuring smaller, more fragile creatures such as Shearwigs and Dwarf Bulborbs
This strong landing destroys nectar eggs immediately, defeats Mitites in a wide radius, and can instantly deactivate fire geysers and electrical wires.
Because the "thud" counts as an attack, it can be used to damage poison emitters and Fiery Bulblaxes
They also do not panic when encountering Mitites or hearing the roar of Emperor Bulblaxes.
Purple Pikmin cannot move as quickly as other Pikmin types, and move even slower when carrying objects.
Some bosses are harder to stun, or may not be stunned at all

lines.line: Summary: The smallest and fastest Pikmin: flowered ones run at least as quickly as a leader with Rush Boots. Their red eyes let them find treasure that is completely buried underground. In Pikmin 2 you make them by throwing Pikmin into the Ivory Candypop Buds on the third sublevel of the White Flower Garden.

quoted: White Pikmin are smaller than other types of Pikmin.
They are the fastest of all Pikmin, such that, when flowered, they run at least as quickly as leaders equipped with Rush Boots.
They have red eyes that in Pikmin 2 allow them to locate treasures that are completely buried underground
Captain Olimar first finds the White Pikmin in the White Flower Garden.
On the 3rd sublevel, he runs across 3 Ivory Candypop Buds, and throws his available Pikmin into them to turn them into White Pikmin.

lines.line: Uses: Needed for every fully buried treasure: no other type can do it, exploits included. They also stand through poison gas without choking, so they matter when destroying poison emitters, though other types can do it with difficulty. The page recommends them, though they are not strictly needed, against the Doodlebug, the Munge Dweevil and the Titan Dweevil's poison weapon, and for treasures behind poison-emitter gates such as the Seed of Greed, the Anti-hiccup Fungus and the Geographic Projection.

quoted: White Pikmin are needed for the following treasures and tasks, as no other Pikmin type is up for the job, not even if exploits are used.
Any and all fully buried treasures.
White Pikmin also possess the unique ability to be able to stand through poisonous gases without choking to death, as do Bulbmin.
This makes them quite important when taking out poisonous enemies and destroying poison emitters, although other types of Pikmin might still be able to cause damage, with some difficulty.
White Pikmin are recommended for the following tasks, although they are not strictly necessary.
Doodlebug: They can occasionally shoot gas clouds that can choke non-White Pikmin
Munge Dweevil: This member of the Dweevil family can expel a poisonous compound if provoked enough, but they can be attacked with any Pikmin type.
Titan Dweevil: This boss can shoot poison clouds out of one of its weapons.
Seed of Greed: The section of the Wistful Wild with this treasure is blocked off by two gates with poison emitters
Anti-hiccup Fungus: Same as Seed of Greed.
Geographic Projection: There is a gate covered in poison emitters blocking the way to the treasure.

lines.line: Tips: If an enemy eats one, it ejects poison that hurts the eater at once, often enough to kill a small enemy like a Dwarf Orange Bulborb, but the Pikmin still dies, so keep that as a last resort. Their attack power matches the standard types in Pikmin 2.

quoted: Upon being eaten, White Pikmin eject a poisonous fluid into the eater, which poisons them. This causes instant damage, and is often enough to kill smaller enemies, like a Dwarf Orange Bulborb. With that said, this does not prevent the Pikmin's death, so it should be used as a last resort.
but match the strength of the standard types in Pikmin 2.

lines.line: Summary: The first Pikmin type found in every game, with sharp, pointy noses that give them 1.5 times the attack power of most types, and immune to fire. In Pikmin 2 the first Red Pikmin are five fighting a Dwarf Red Bulborb in the Valley of Repose, right next to where Olimar lands.

quoted: They are the first Pikmin type seen or discovered in all games by the main playable leaders
Red Pikmin have sharp, pointy noses, and as a result, have above average attack power, at 1.5× that of most types.
Red Pikmin also exhibit an immunity to fire, in that they ignore the heat
There are 5 Pikmin fighting a Dwarf Red Bulborb in the Valley of Repose right next to where Olimar lands.

lines.line: Uses: No task in Pikmin 2 needs Red Pikmin specifically, but until another type is found they are required by default. They are intended for the Fiery Bulblax, whose flames only they can withstand: its fire goes out if it is submerged, Purple Pikmin can hurt it with their landing, White Pikmin can be eaten by it to poison it, and in certain caves it can be lured into the abyss. They are intended for treasures guarded by a Fiery Bulblax with no water around, such as the Essence of Despair, the Frosty Bauble, the Gemstar Wife and the Insect Condo, and for carrying the Gyroid Bust through fire geysers unless the geysers are destroyed.

quoted: There is no task in the game that can only be completed with Red Pikmin specifically. However, as they are the first type discovered, they are by default required until another type is obtained.

Fiery Bulblax: Only Red Pikmin can withstand its flames. However, if the enemy is submerged, its fire goes out. Even with the fire active, Purple Pikmin can damage it with their impact damage, and White Pikmin can be ingested to poison it. In certain caves, it can be lured into walking into the abyss as well.
Essence of Despair: There is no water around to defeat the Fiery Bulblax with other Pikmin, so Red Pikmin are intended.
Frosty Bauble: Same as the Essence of Despair.
Gemstar Wife: Same as the Essence of Despair.
Insect Condo: Same as the Essence of Despair.
Gyroid Bust: They are intended to carry the piece through fire geysers, unless careful timing, whistles, and fast carrying strategies are used or the fire geysers are destroyed.

lines.line: Tips: Their fire immunity matters less in Pikmin 2 than in other games: any Pikmin can destroy fire geysers, Fiery Blowhogs fall easily to Purple Pikmin, and Fiery Dweevils and the Titan Dweevil's flame weapon can be beaten with any type. In 2-Player Battle, player 1 gets Red Pikmin and player 2 gets Blue Pikmin with the same 1.5 times attack power.

quoted: Their ability is less useful in Pikmin 2, where the geysers can be destroyed by any Pikmin, and Fiery Blowhogs can easily be defeated with Purple Pikmin.
Their main use in the second game is for defeating Fiery Bulblaxes, though this task doesn't always require them.
Fiery Dweevil: This enemy can set a large group of Pikmin on fire at once, but can be defeated with any Pikmin type.
Titan Dweevil: This boss can shoot fire out of its flamethrower-based weapon, but can be defeated with any Pikmin type.
In 2-Player Battle in Pikmin 2, player 1's army is made up of Red Pikmin, while player 2's army is made up of Blue Pikmin.
Blue Pikmin are given the same 1.5× attack power
